sources_note: WebFetch could not reach the makers' sites from the cloud box, so each page was read on 16 Nov 2026 with DataForSEO's page reader (on_page/content_parsing/live), as VOICE.md allows; the editor re-read several live in later rounds. Ethos's row comes from messages/en.json, messages/es.json, src/lib/pricing/products.ts, src/config/site.ts and the template manifests.

reviews.summary: 10: nine real sites in dated side-by-side tables, 'not stated' instead of guesses, its own maker's weak points admitted, then which to pick for free tonight, voice or video, or midnight in their time zone. Polish only.

dealbreakers: Claim about another maker the sources don't show: 2luv is recommended for writing in 'Spanish, German or Portuguese'. Its page (sources/2luv.txt, and a live re-read today) only says 'In 12 languages, from English to Japanese' and doesn't list the languages.

Claim about another maker the sources don't show: LovePaper is listed for opening 'at midnight' and 'Opens at a set time: Yes'. Its page only offers 'a scheduled opening date' / 'schedule the letter to open on a special date', with no time.

Claim about another maker the sources don't show: LetterHugs 'let you build and preview before paying'. Its page says 'Create unlimited drafts for free... Pay only at send step'. The only mention of a preview is in a customer quote.
Claim about another maker the sources don't show: gifft.me photos 'One'. The page says 'choose your own photo or select from our collection' and gives no number.

Claim about Ethos the files don't support as worded: 'Video clips ... with any paid option'. Only 5 of 61 manifests have features.video: true (the-letter, birthday-cinema, garden, museum, our-timeline), and editor-shell.tsx only shows VideoSection when manifest.features.video is set. Both premium templates the post features (xoxo, keepsake) have video: false. pricing.freeNote uses the same wording, but the manifests settle it per template. '20 photos with any paid option' has the same problem: xoxo and keepsake allow 9, and only 6 templates allow 20.
